summary: Vodafone Group via subsidiary Vodacom completed an acquisition of an effective 20% stake in Safaricom Plc for KES 272 billion total (~€1.81B). Vodacom bought 15% from the Government of Kenya for KES 204B (€1.36B) and 5% from a Vodafone subsidiary for KES 68B (€0.45B), raising its holding to 55%. The transaction, announced 4 Dec 2025, closes with Safaricom fully consolidated by both Vodacom and Vodafone. No board recommendation or advisors named. Watch for integration execution and regulatory implications in Kenya.
